coreMemory.english: n. how good or bad something is
coreMemory.structure: high quality /haɪ ˈkwɑːləti/（高质量）；quality of life /ˈkwɑːləti ʌv laɪf/（生活质量）；improve the quality of /ɪmpruv ðə ˈkwɑːləti ʌv/（提高……质量）；good-quality materials /ɡʊd-ˈkwɑːləti mətɪriəlz/（优质材料）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ use quality with the same article in every context → ✅ check the countability of quality in context；❌ translate quality word by word → ✅ learn the complete phrase “high quality”

commonErrors.wrong: use quality with the same article in every context
commonErrors.wrongPhonetic: /jus ˈkwɑːləti wɪð ðə seɪm ɑrtəkəl ɪn ɛvɚi kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.right: check the countability of quality in context
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /tʃɛk ðə countability ʌv ˈkwɑːləti ɪn kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.note: 同一个名词在不同义项下可能有可数、不可数或单复数差异，不能机械套用冠词。
不要只按中文逐字替换；优先把本卡高频搭配作为完整句块记忆。
